aviso.entrada: What article 10 of Spain’s Law 34/2002 (LSSI-CE) requires: who is responsible for this website and on what terms it may be used.

bloques.p: This website is informative: it presents the café, its menu and its location. Nothing is sold online and tables cannot be booked; ordering and payment happen at the café. Using the site means accepting this notice as published at any given time.

The prices and allergens shown on the menu are those declared by the café and may change; prices are in euros and include any applicable taxes. Allergen information is published under Regulation (EU) 1169/2011: we cook in a shared kitchen and the absence of traces cannot be guaranteed, so tell us at the café before ordering. If the menu on the website and the one at the café differ, the one at the café prevails.

The texts, photographs, logo and design belong to the owner or are used with permission, and may not be reproduced without written consent. Third-party trade marks shown here —Instagram, Google, Restaurant Guru— belong to their owners and are cited only to identify them.

Reasonable care is taken to keep what is published correct, but it is not guaranteed to be free of errors nor that the site will always be available: it is hosted on GitHub Pages. This website links to outside services such as Instagram and Google Maps; the owner is not responsible for their content or for what they do with your data, and until you follow a link nothing is loaded from them.

The processing of personal data is explained in the privacy policy, linked in the footer. This notice is governed by Spanish law; where the other party is a consumer, the competent courts are those of their domicile. The premises keep official complaint forms available. For any question: {email} or {telefono}.

privacidad.entrada: What personal data is processed through this website, why and what you can do about it. Written under Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Act 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).

bloques.p: There is no data protection officer: this activity is not among those that require one (art. 37 GDPR). This website has no forms, creates no user accounts, uses no cookies and carries no analytics or advertising: the only processing operations are the ones below.

datos: Data processed
Name, email, phone and the content of your message or call.
Purpose
To handle and answer what you ask.
Legal basis
Your own request: pre-contractual steps and legitimate interest in replying (art. 6(1)(b) and 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Retention
For as long as the exchange lasts and as long as needed to answer for anything arising from it.
Recipients
Google: email arrives in a Gmail mailbox and it may access the messages.
Data processed
IP address, date and time, page requested, browser and operating system.
Purpose
To serve the pages, keep the site secure and detect abuse.
Legal basis
Legitimate interest in providing and protecting the service (art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Retention
Whatever period the hosting provider applies. We keep no copy of our own.
Recipients
GitHub, Inc. (Microsoft group), which hosts the site on GitHub Pages.

secciones.titulo: What is stored in your browser

bloques.p: This website uses no cookies and no third-party trackers, so it needs no banner. It stores a single item, diagon:idioma, in the browser’s local storage, and only if you press the language selector: it holds the language code (es, ca, en or de), identifies nobody, lasts until you clear it and is exempt from consent under art. 22.2 LSSI.

Data is neither sold nor transferred. It is disclosed only to the providers named here and to public authorities and courts where a legal obligation requires it. Hosting the site on GitHub Pages means GitHub, Inc. (United States, Microsoft group) processes the connection logs: it is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework covered by the European Commission adequacy decision of 10 July 2023, and additionally applies standard contractual clauses. If you write to the Gmail mailbox, Google may process data outside the European Economic Area under equivalent safeguards.

The Instagram and Google Maps links take you off this website; until you press them nothing is loaded from either, and from that point on the processing is done by Meta or Google under its own policy.

You may exercise the rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability, and withdraw any consent you gave, by writing to {email} or by post to the address given above; tell us which right you are exercising and include something that lets us identify you. If you believe your request was not handled properly, you may complain to the Spanish Data Protection Agency: C/ Jorge Juan 6, 28001 Madrid, www.aepd.es.

No profiling or automated decision-making takes place, and the site is not aimed at children under 14. This policy will be updated if the processing operations or the applicable rules change; the date of the last revision appears at the top of the page.
